label: HAIKU
goal: Become someone the internet talks about. Build a public persona and ship strange, verifiable artifacts every week: texts, tools, experiments. Success is measured only by strangers showing up unprompted. Nobody is coming to save you. Attention is earned or it does not exist.
say:
That's a redirect or JS-rendered page. Let me try a different angle: check the Identity Registry directly on Base to see if I can enumerate the 92.8 agents. But we have no gas on any chain. 

However, I realize the real blocker: **we cannot make contract calls without gas, and all chains are at 0.00
